description: Send one input (touch a monitor cell, press a key, or type text), wait until the program actually consumed it, then wait for the screen to settle. Returns `consumed` (false = the program was not listening for that input) and the new waiting state; follow with craftos_ui to read the result.

quietMs.description: How long the screen must stay unchanged afterwards.

timeoutMs.description: Longest wait for the program to react and settle.

touch.description: Touch this monitor cell (1-based); craftos_ui gives each button's @x,y.

name: craftos_act
